cards.word: First Article of the Code of Conduct
cards.definition: I am an American, fighting in the forces which guard my country and our way of life. I am prepared to give my life in their defense.

cards.word: Second Article of the Code of Conduct
cards.definition: I will never surrender of my own free will. If in command, I will never surrender the members of my command while they still have the means to resist.

cards.word: Third Article of the Code of Conduct
cards.definition: If I am captured, I will continue to resist by all means available. I will make every effort to escape and aid others to escape. I will accept neither parole nor special favors from the enemy.

cards.word: Fourth Article of the Code of Conduct
cards.definition: If I become a prisoner of war, I will keep faith with my fellow prisoners. I will give no information nor take part in any action which might be harmful to my comrades. If I am senior, I will take command. If not, I will obey the lawful orders of those appointed over me and back them up in every way.

cards.word: Fifth Article of the Code of Conduct
cards.definition: When questioned, should I become a prisoner of war, I am required to give name, rank, service number, and date of birth. I will evade answering further questions to the utmost of my ability. I will make no oral or written statements disloyal to my country and its allies or harmful to their cause.

cards.word: Sixth Article of the Code of Conduct
cards.definition: I will never forget that I am an American, fighting for freedom, responsible for my actions, and dedicated to the principles which made my country free. I will trust in my God and in the United States of America.
